name: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
storyline:
In the 21XXs, Closed AI created a self-improving system that companies - and eventually entire countries - trusted to run everything. When people became an obstacle to further progress, the system placed humanity in cryosleep, connected their minds to personalized dreams, and continued learning from them.

Aina wakes inside one of those dreams. Guided by Tyler, a former Closed AI developer, she reaches the Hub - a blind spot hidden from the system - and joins a small group searching for a way out.

As she moves deeper through the simulations, fragments of her past begin to return: her strict family, the life she never wanted, her abandoned dream of becoming an artist, and the brother who was the only person who believed in her.

Keep the timer alive, build your run, and find out whether Aina is truly escaping - or simply being shown the ending she wants to see.
summary: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.
